sirt_reconstruct — TOMOGRAPHY ct_scan op

• 資料種類:projstack × ctgeometry → voxel

• 呼叫: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.sirt_reconstruct(projections, geometry, n_iter=50, relaxation=1.0, initial=None, nonnegative=True, device='auto', on_iter=None)(要直接呼叫實作,import ctscan; ctscan.sirt_reconstruct(projections, geometry, n_iter=50, relaxation=1.0, initial=None, nonnegative=True, device='auto', on_iter=None);從台帳取用則 opstomography.get("sirt_reconstruct"))

• GPU:無(僅 CPU 參考實作)

用法

SIRT：同時使用全部視角，x <- x + lam C A^T R (p - A x)。

> 以下的詳細說明為原文 —— 摘要與標題已翻譯。

R and C are the inverse row and column sums of A. With the matched pair of this family it minimises a weighted least-squares error, and it needs no formula, so it is the route for tomosynthesis, few views and limited angle.

:param projections: (view, V, U) line integrals. :param geometry: dict from ct_scan_geometry. :param n_iter: iterations, 1 .. 5000. :param relaxation: step lam, (0, 2). :param initial: starting volume; None gives zeros. :param nonnegative: clip to >= 0 after each iteration. :param device: "auto", "cpu" or "cuda". :param on_iter: optional on_iter(iteration, volume) for a convergence curve;

returning a boolean True (bool or numpy.bool_) stops after

that iteration; any other return value (None, numbers, dicts,

arrays) is ignored.

:returns: (Z, Y, X) float volume. :raises ValueError: on a shape that disagrees with the geometry or a relaxation

outside (0, 2). Empty input (projections with 0 elements) raises

ValueError.

The default 50 iterations is not converged. SIRT moves slowly. On consistent data (24^3 Shepp-Logan, cone, 20 views) the relative residual is 0.0318 at 50 iterations and 0.0087 at 200, and the nRMS to the truth drops from 0.0407 to 0.0232 (43 %); on the measured walnut (fan, 50 views) the RMSE to the reference is 0.0055 /mm at 60 iterations and 0.0036 at 400 (2026-11-09 audit). Comparing methods at the defaults makes SIRT look worse than it is. Choose n_iter from a curve: on_iter can compute the residual |A x - p| / |p| (ct_forward_project) or the error on held-out views, and return True once its relative change falls below e.g. 1e-3. With noisy data the error to the truth reaches a minimum and then rises again (semi-convergence), so the residual alone is not a stopping rule there.
